Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候：在古代
- 但是城市有才两个学校：这个城市，只有

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，this phrase redundantly combines a time period with a “time of” expression; use the concise time expression instead. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 有才两个学校：只有两个学校，use “只有” to express that the city has only two schools; “有才” does not form this limited-quantity pattern. [teacher rule: zhiyou_caiyou]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子：一个叫孟子的男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国，at first mention, introduce the character with both a noun and his name rather than naming him only in the following sentence. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他的城市：自己的城市，when the city belongs to or is associated with the subject, use “自己” to make the possessor clearly refer back to him. [teacher rule: ziji_possessor]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 但是城市：但是它，because “城市” was just mentioned, use a pronoun for this close re-occurrence rather than repeating the noun. [rule: ambiguous_reference]

items.reason: 古代和……的时候语义重复，老师要求改为“在古代”。
“有才两个学校”不能表达“only two schools”，应使用“只有两个学校”。
首次介绍角色时应同时说明其身份和名字，避免下一句才补出名字。
此处“他的城市”已经清楚指孟子，使用“自己的城市”可以但不是必须修改。
“城市”在这里需要有明确指称，如“这个城市”或“它”；但所显示的“但是它”本身不是完整句子。
